issues.detail: Hebrew 'בִּקְדֹּשָׁו' (in His holy ones) is rendered as '他們雖獻為聖' (though they are consecrated/offered as holy), which changes the subject from God's holy ones/angels to a human act of consecration. The Hebrew means 'even His holy ones He does not trust,' not 'they are consecrated but do not believe.'
